entries.heading: The Secretary of Agriculture
ancestors: DIVISION A—AGRICULTURE, RURAL DEVELOPMENT, FOOD AND DRUG ADMINISTRATION, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2022
entries.text:
Sec. 744. The Secretary of Agriculture 
may waive the matching funds requirement under section 412(g) of the 
Agricultural Research, Extension, and Education Reform Act of 1998 (7 
U.S.C. 7632(g)).
